description: This file defines the SimpleServiceEngine class which extends GenericAsyncEngine and provides methods to run services synchronously, either returning results or ignoring them. It interacts with service dispatchers, model services, and invokes simple methods related to the minimal language service engine within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SimpleServiceEngine
classes.description: A final class extending GenericAsyncEngine, responsible for executing services both synchronously and asynchronously within the OFBiz minilang framework, utilizing service dispatchers and model services.

methods.name: SimpleServiceEngine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the engine with a given ServiceDispatcher.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously, returning the result map, and throws an exception if the result is null.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously but ignores the result.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Invokes the simple service method, handling class loading and exceptions, returning the result map.
